title: I made a "zoo" to debug my animations
author: LatentBlade
selftext: These aren't perfect and that's the point. I needed an easy to see them all and see what's not working. All of these were made using nano banana 2 and Krita.

comments.author: LatentBlade
comments.body: u/RealisticValuable484 this in response to the haters in your thread. You're on the right track. Make cool characters first. Use them as references.

replies.author: RealisticValuable484
replies.body:
Wow, that’s awesome! Thanks for being positive, I’m glad it could be useful for you.

I also saw your comment about using API/ComfyUI. Right now, I do not really plan to use those tools because I do not have the motivation to make a game by myself.

For now, I just want to focus on making, testing, and experimenting with AI concept art.

replies.author: LatentBlade
replies.body: Nice. I want to get my animations good enough and get back to working on my game loop...

replies.author: RealisticValuable484
replies.body:
That’s cool. Another reason I have not started making sprite sheets with AI is because AI image models are still not good enough yet.

Since you are so kind to chare some of your work. Let me share what I'm working on next :) .The next thing I’m working on is character splash art or hero reveal posters. I can do this for a brand-new character even without a reference image. I can also make a poster for an existing character if you attach a reference image. From my testing so far, the art style stays very consistent.  
Example below, I was able to make one for omni man and Nisha and the remaining characters are original custom made characters.

https://preview.redd.it/2gkawuhi02tg1.png?width=1920&format=png&auto=webp&s=52dc364173348ddb6eda96dc0b5604ab88ce66c1

replies.author: LatentBlade
replies.body: These are cool. Maybe I need something like these for victory overlays

replies.author: RealisticValuable484
replies.body: Yeah, that would be a great idea. Are you building like a 2d fighting game?

replies.author: LatentBlade
replies.body: Not quite. This is actually for a deck builder and I just wanted to push my skills.

comments.author: LatentBlade
comments.body: I feel like nano banana got nerfed so I stopped putting these back in for a second call. Workflow is generate consistent reference characters. Use jupyter notebook to run same prompts over and over which green screen then. Gamble a little on the output. Remove green screen and stitch them together in Krita.

comments.author: LatentBlade
comments.body: The alternative to the zoo was either playing every level or changing my code to load a different character for the first level. This is so much faster.

comments.author: Dependent_Car_3675
